info.title: Ruxbase API (scoped reference)
info.description: Development documentation. Scoped public and administrative API contracts. Collection-specific schemas, full settings definitions and exhaustive errors are not specified. Not a complete REST specification or production certification.

get.description: Reads a file associated with a record. Protected files are subject to the collection view rule and file-token authentication context; public files have different access behavior. Use protected fields for private content. Requested supported thumbnails may fall back to the original. Response media type depends on the file.

200.description: File content; media type depends on the asset.

default.description: File unavailable or request failed.

Record.description: Collection-defined record. Fields and even standard metadata may be restricted by field selection or permissions.

totalItems.description: May be -1 when totals are skipped.

totalPages.description: May be -1 when totals are skipped.

AuthMethods.description: Enabled methods and collection-specific settings. Provider entries and legacy fields may be present.

CollectionSummary.description: Collection model; returned properties vary by type and configuration. This scoped schema does not describe every collection field or configuration option.

Settings.description: Administrative settings object; individual settings and sensitive values are intentionally not enumerated in this scoped contract. Treat responses as confidential.

RLSInspection.description: Compiled policies and status. The result is diagnostic and not a guarantee of complete tenant isolation.

RecordToken.name: Authorization
RecordToken.description: Record authentication token. Guest access is only available when the configured collection rule permits it.

SuperuserToken.name: Authorization
SuperuserToken.description: Valid superuser authentication token. Do not expose administrative tokens in client-side applications or documentation. Normal record tokens do not grant administrative authority.

FileToken.name: token
FileToken.description: Short-lived file token where required by protected-file access rules; avoid logging or sharing token-bearing URLs.

x-ruxbase-coverage: partial: 31 operations; excludes OAuth2 authentication, impersonation, multipart uploads, collection import/truncate/view dry-run, settings test routes, backup creation/download/restore/delete, logs, cron, SQL, RLS tokens, batch, realtime, MCP and custom routes
